type: Original reanalysis of third-party public raw measurements; no new workload executed

formulas.normalized_direct_cost: estimated billedSeconds / 3600 * (AWS current on-demand instance rate + raw EBS hourly estimate)
formulas.cost_per_success: sum of all observed job cost estimates / number of successful jobs; no failed job silently dropped
formulas.scenario_IPv4_calendar_EBS: estimated billedSeconds / 3600 * (on-demand EC2 + $13.40/calendar-month-hours + $0.005/hour for one assumed public IPv4)
formulas.warning: Repricing spot execution at on-demand is a counterfactual estimate, not an observed on-demand invoice. Complete invoice costs and independent workload rerun remain missing.

primary_8vCPU_sensitivity.interpretation: Cloud retail break-even, never Intel CPU invoice price or retained producer margin. Shared fixed cost leaves absolute savings unchanged but lowers percentage savings; a differential cost above the threshold could reverse the direct-cost ranking.
